definition: in a hidden way so nobody notices
description: An elegant dinner in a room with gold mirrors, candelabras and a chandelier. A young woman with long braids in a blue satin dress sits at the long white table and smiles towards the others, while low beside the tablecloth, where nobody can see, she holds out a fork with a piece of roast meat to a big grey dog, which licks it. Then she lifts the fork back and sits up straight. The other guests clap, a woman in a green dress waves, and a waiter in a white jacket stands behind.

taps.target: the man in the bow tie
